COMPREHENSIVE MASTER IT PROCUREMENT AND SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master IT Procurement and Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of November 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Acme Corporation, a Delaware corporation having its principal office at 100 Enterprise Way, Suite 400, Wilmington, DE 19801 ("Client"), and CloudTech Solutions Inc., a California corporation having its principal office at 500 Silicon Vista, San Francisco, CA 94107 ("Provider"). Client and Provider may collectively be referred to as the "Parties" or individually as a "Party."

RECITALS
WHEREAS, Provider is an established provider of mission-critical cloud software architecture, scalable data infrastructure, and systems integration services;
WHEREAS, Client desires to procure comprehensive IT modernization, automated containerization, and enterprise compliance services from Provider; and
WHEREAS, Provider desires to provide such services and technical deliverables to Client under the terms, representations, warranties, and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, premises, and promises herein contained, the Parties agree as follows:

SECTION 1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
1.1 "Agreement" means this Comprehensive Master IT Procurement and Professional Services Agreement, together with all attached Exhibits, Schedules, and Statements of Work incorporated herein by reference.

The Parties expressly recognize that the covenants set forth in this Section 1 are essential to the allocation of risk and commercial consideration between the Parties. Provider shall exercise continuous professional diligence to satisfy all requirements and milestones related to this provision. Client shall retain full oversight and verification authority to ensure comprehensive compliance with prevailing federal and state laws.

SECTION 5. DATA SECURITY, PRIVACY AND ABA RULE 1.6 CONFIDENTIALITY
5.1 Information Security Program. Provider shall establish, maintain, and enforce a comprehensive written administrative, technical, and physical information security program complying with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and NIST Cybersecurity Framework standards.

5.2 Air-Gapped and Local Processing Guarantee. For all legal document analysis features, processing shall take place locally within the client browser memory. Provider guarantees zero-network transmission of confidential document contents to external server nodes.

The Parties expressly recognize that the covenants set forth in this Section 5 are essential to the allocation of risk and commercial consideration between the Parties. Provider shall exercise continuous professional diligence to satisfy all requirements and milestones related to this provision. Client shall retain full oversight and verification authority to ensure comprehensive compliance with prevailing federal and state laws.

5.3 Data Encryption Standards. Provider shall encrypt all Client Data in transit using TLS 1.3 or higher cryptographic ciphers, and at rest using AES-256 bit encryption keys managed under dedicated hardware security modules.

The Parties expressly recognize that the covenants set forth in this Section 5 are essential to the allocation of risk and commercial consideration between the Parties. Provider shall exercise continuous professional diligence to satisfy all requirements and milestones related to this provision. Client shall retain full oversight and verification authority to ensure comprehensive compliance with prevailing federal and state laws.

5.4 Security Incident Notification. In the event of any confirmed or suspected unauthorized access, breach, acquisition, or alteration of Client Data, Provider shall immediately alert Client within twenty-four hours of discovery.

The Parties expressly recognize that the covenants set forth in this Section 5 are essential to the allocation of risk and commercial consideration between the Parties.
